notes.title: See your page in Google
notes.text: The page and blog post forms now show a Google result preview for a phone and a computer. Open a page or post and look under Search engines.

notes.title: Edit blocks in a side sheet
notes.text: On a phone, a block’s fields and the section settings now open in a side sheet over the page, and on a tablet they stand beside it.
The action bar at the bottom of a phone is now a standard bottom sheet
The hint on an empty line in the text editor follows the editor’s language and says the first heading is an H1
On a page, the heading menus offer only H1 until the text has one, then H2 and H3
